title: Tangent maps at rational points are dual to cotangent maps
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $f:X\to Y$ a morphism of $k$-schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and $x\in X$, $y=f(x)\in Y$ points with $\kappa(x)=\kappa(y)=k$. Write $\mathfrak m_x$ and $\mathfrak m_y$ for the maximal ideals in the respective local rings. With the tangent spaces and the tangent map induced by $f$ as in [def-sc-scheme-tangent-space], there are canonical $k$-linear isomorphisms $T_{X/k,x}\cong\operatorname{Hom}_k(\mathfrak m_x/\mathfrak m_x^2,k)$ and $T_{Y/k,y}\cong\operatorname{Hom}_k(\mathfrak m_y/\mathfrak m_y^2,k)$. Under these isomorphisms the tangent map $T_{X/k,x}\to T_{Y/k,y}$ induced by $f$ is the dual of the $k$-linear map $\mathfrak m_y/\mathfrak m_y^2\to\mathfrak m_x/\mathfrak m_x^2$ induced by the local-ring homomorphism $\mathcal O_{Y,y}\to\mathcal O_{X,x}$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-rational-point-tangent-derivation-identification] to $X$ at $x$ and to $Y$ at $y$; the hypotheses $\kappa(x)=k$ and $\kappa(y)=k$ are exactly its rational-point hypotheses. This gives the two canonical $k$-linear isomorphisms of the conclusion, $\theta\mapsto\ell_\theta$ on $T_{X/k,x}$ and $\eta\mapsto\ell_\eta$ on $T_{Y/k,y}$, where $\ell_\theta(a\bmod\mathfrak m_x^2)=D_\theta(a)$ is read off from $\theta^\sharp(a)=\bar a+D_\theta(a)\epsilon$.

proof.text: Let $f^\sharp_x:\mathcal O_{Y,y}\to\mathcal O_{X,x}$ be the local homomorphism induced by $f$ [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism]; it maps $\mathfrak m_y$ into $\mathfrak m_x$ and $\mathfrak m_y^2$ into $\mathfrak m_x^2$, so it induces a $k$-linear map $u:\mathfrak m_y/\mathfrak m_y^2\to\mathfrak m_x/\mathfrak m_x^2$; and since the induced map $\kappa(y)\to\kappa(x)$ [def-weil-residue-field] is a $k$-algebra map between copies of $k$, it is the identity, i.e. $\overline{f^\sharp_x(b)}=\bar b$. By [def-sc-scheme-tangent-space] the tangent map sends $\theta\in T_{X/k,x}$ to $f\circ\theta$. By [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-stalk-map-composition](b), $(f\circ\theta)^\sharp=\theta^\sharp\circ f^\sharp_x$ (the same germ isomorphism of $k[\epsilon]$ is used on both sides). Hence for $b\in\mathcal O_{Y,y}$: $\bar b+D_{f\circ\theta}(b)\epsilon=\theta^\sharp(f^\sharp_x(b))=\bar b+D_\theta(f^\sharp_x(b))\epsilon$, so $D_{f\circ\theta}=D_\theta\circ f^\sharp_x$, and for $b\in\mathfrak m_y$ this reads $\ell_{f\circ\theta}(b\bmod\mathfrak m_y^2)=\ell_\theta(u(b\bmod\mathfrak m_y^2))$, i.e. $\ell_{f\circ\theta}=u^*(\ell_\theta)$ with the descriptions of step 1 [lem-sc-rational-point-tangent-derivation-identification]. Thus under the isomorphisms of step 1 the tangent map is the dual $u^*$ of the cotangent map.

lean.statement: theorem rational_tangent_cotangent_duality (k : Type u) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (pX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (pY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ pY = pX) (x : X) : let RX := X.presheaf.stalk x let RY := Y.presheaf.stalk (f x) let KX := X.residueField x let KY := Y.residueField (f x) let rX : k →+* KX := (StructureSheaf.toStalk k (pX x) ≫ pX.stalkMap x ≫ X.residue x).hom let rY : k →+* KY := (StructureSheaf.toStalk k (pY (f x)) ≫ pY.stalkMap (f x) ≫ Y.residue (f x)).hom Function.Bijective rX → Function.Bijective rY → letI : Module k (schemeTangentSpace k X pX x) := Module.compHom (schemeTangentSpace k X pX x) rX letI : Module k (schemeTangentSpace k Y pY (f x)) := Module.compHom (schemeTangentSpace k Y pY (f x)) rY letI : Module KX (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace RX) := inferInstanceAs (Module (IsLocalRing.ResidueField RX) (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace RX)) letI : Module KY (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace RY) := inferInstanceAs (Module (IsLocalRing.ResidueField RY) (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace RY)) letI : Module k (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace RX) := Module.compHom (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace RX) rX letI : Module k (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace RY) := Module.compHom (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace RY) rY ∃ he : Function.Bijective (f.residueFieldMap x).hom, ∃ (EX : schemeTangentSpace k X pX x ≃ₗ[k] (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace RX →ₗ[k] k)) (EY : schemeTangentSpace k Y pY (f x) ≃ₗ[k] (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace RY →ₗ[k] k)) (U : IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace RY →ₗ[k] IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace RX), (∀ θ : schemeTangentSpace k X pX x, ∃ hx : θ.val (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (DualNumber KX)) = x, let sharp : RX →+* DualNumber KX := (eqToHom (congrArg (fun z : X ↦ X.presheaf.stalk z) hx.symm) ≫ Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo θ.val).hom ∃! D : RX → k, (∀ a : RX, sharp a = TrivSqZeroExt.inl ((X.residue x).hom a) + TrivSqZeroExt.inr (rX (D a))) ∧ (∀ a : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal RX, EX θ ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal RX).toCotangent a) = D a)) ∧ (∀ θ : schemeTangentSpace k Y pY (f x), ∃ hy : θ.val (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (DualNumber KY)) = f x, let sharp : RY →+* DualNumber KY := (eqToHom (congrArg (fun z : Y ↦ Y.presheaf.stalk z) hy.symm) ≫ Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo θ.val).hom ∃! D : RY → k, (∀ a : RY, sharp a = TrivSqZeroExt.inl ((Y.residue (f x)).hom a) + TrivSqZeroExt.inr (rY (D a))) ∧ (∀ a : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal RY, EY θ ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal RY).toCotangent a) = D a)) ∧ (∀ b : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal RY, ∃ hb : (f.stalkMap x).hom b ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal RX, U ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal RY).toCotangent b) = (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal RX).toCotangent ⟨(f.stalkMap x).hom b, hb⟩) ∧ ∀ θ : schemeTangentSpace k X pX x, EY (schemeTangentMap k X Y pX pY f hf x he θ) = (EX θ).comp U
